title: Integrative bioinformatics analysis and experimental validation of key biomarkers driving the progression of cirrhotic portal hypertension
summary: The study reports OIT3 and LOXL1 as candidate cirrhotic portal-hypertension biomarkers and links them with disease-associated expression and pathways. The authors report an independent GEO cohort and clinical-tissue RT-qPCR/IHC. OIT3 replicated, while LOXL1 expression and diagnostic performance did not replicate adequately (validation AUC 0.6169); this limits the claim.
ai_technology: LASSO, random forest and SVM-RFE screened transcriptomic candidate genes; their intersection selected OIT3 and LOXL1 for subsequent testing.
